scope: The runs of the page and of native Agda that ADR 0003 cites besides the conformance suite: Agda's answer to Cmd_abort natively; the real page driven in headless Chromium (hover, case split, refine, STOP, a PLFA chapter's check, Infer in an unchecked chapter, coming back to a file Agda holds), with controls on the page's code before the self-review's fixes; the browser check in Firefox; and the contrast report with and without the views' styles.  Each is a single observation, not a benchmark.  Paths are shortened: <repository> is the worktree, <root> a probe's project directory, <scratch> the session's scratch directory.

nativeAbort.what: agda --interaction-json at da66a8c7 (the flake's .#vscode shell): load Slow.agda, start a slow normalization, send Cmd_abort 500 ms after it, then ask a goal's type; each line of Agda's output with its time since the start (highlighting lines left out).
nativeAbort.source:
module Slow where

data N : Set where
  z : N
  s : N → N

_⊕_ : N → N → N
z ⊕ n = n
s m ⊕ n = s (m ⊕ n)

slow : N → N
slow z = s z
slow (s n) = slow n ⊕ slow n

goal : N
goal = {! !}

page.what: The built page (make build at this revision) in headless Chromium: the first check of Main, a hover, a case split and the check after it, a refine, STOP during a PLFA chapter's first check, and that chapter's check.

abort.bar: Agda ready | 0 goals |  | Agda 2.9.0 | WASI · local | UTF-8

plfa.bar: Checked | 0 goals |  | Agda 2.9.0 | WASI · local | UTF-8

pageScope.what: A case split inside a where block; Infer of _+_ in a PLFA chapter that was opened but not checked; then back to the playground.

back.bar: Agda ready | 3 goals |  | Agda 2.9.0 | WASI · local | UTF-8

control.change: src/lib/controller.svelte.ts and src/routes/+page.svelte as at 7543c7d (before the page's fixes), the rest at 1f4e5d2; built, probed, and restored by name.

back.bar: Agda ready | 3 goals |  | Agda 2.9.0 | WASI · local | UTF-8

pageReturn.what: Check Main, open a PLFA chapter without checking it, and come back: the page's state, and the editor's keyword marks (Agda's highlighting).

control.change: src/lib/controller.svelte.ts and src/routes/+page.svelte as at 7543c7d, the rest at 1f4e5d2; built, probed, and restored by name.  Its output is copied from the run's printed output.

firefox.what: The browser check (scripts/browser-check/run.mjs) in Firefox, four times without and four times with the isolation headers.
firefox.command: FIREFOX=/snap/bin/firefox timeout 300 node scripts/browser-check/run.mjs build --browser firefox [--isolated] --out <scratch>/evidence/firefox/<run>

contrast.what: The contrast report (node scripts/browser-check/contrast.mjs), whose text colors come from the style sources it lists, with the views' components in that list and without them (the list edited, and restored by name).
